description: Permissions for the iPhone's one window, whose Settings tab shows the Settings panes in place: the editor settings, fonts (importing one through the Files picker, which hands Rust a copy it checks), the keyboard shortcuts, the AI providers (the key only goes in), Sync (pairing, joining, devices and status, the recovery key until it is saved), the licence and its Buy page, the App Store's products, a purchase and Restore Purchases (which answer only in an App Store build), copying to the clipboard, and the share sheet that offers the Mac License Key. iOS only: the Mac keeps these in its Settings window. Add a command here only when a phone settings pane needs it.
